caption_L1: Here a area chart is named Number of road traffic fatalities in Russia from 2006 to 2019. The y-axis plots Number of fatalities using a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 35,000. A linear scale from 2006 to 2018 can be found on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: Between 2006 and 2010 there was a downward trend in the number of fatalities in Russia. There was a slight spike between 2010 and 2014. There is a further downward trend between 2014 and 2018.
